title: Dual Form of Ridge Regression (Kernel Ridge Regression)
prompt: Prove why the **Dual Form of Ridge Regression (Kernel Ridge Regression)** $\hat{w} = X^T (X X^T + \lambda I_n)^{-1} y$ is faster to compute than the primal form when number of features $d \gg$ number of samples $n$ (using the Woodbury Matrix Identity).
